title: Hush the Wumpus
tagline: Follow the stink. Steer the dart. Let it sleep.
teaser: Somewhere in the dark, a huge, grumpy, very smelly wumpus is snoring. Map the cave by draft, flutter and whiff, dodge the pits and the bats, then thread a sleep dart through up to five tunnels and send it off to sleep. The 1973 cave hunt that started it all, redrawn by lantern light.

manPage.synopsis: hush — map a cave by draft, flutter and whiff, then steer a sleep dart to put the wumpus to sleep.
manPage.description: Gregory Yob wrote Hunt the Wumpus in 1973 for People’s Computer Company; Dave Taylor’s BSD wump dug crooked caves whose tunnels sometimes run one way. Hush the Wumpus keeps every rule, from the smell two rooms off to the crooked darts, and adds a map that draws itself, a notebook for your deductions, a dart you ride through the tunnels, and the magic tunnels the old code never dug.

howToPlay: Walk from room to room; drafts, flutters and whiffs tell you what lies one or two tunnels away.
Mark rooms in your notebook and keep clear of pits and bats.
Aim a sleep dart through up to five rooms; only the room where it lands counts.
